2.notes: Correct where strcmp returns exactly +-1 (ucrt, my clang run). glibc/x86-64 returns byte differences so '==1' fails there; the claim's transcriber note already says this.

Steps/rubric/pitfalls follow same code; the example and step data are non-negative so all steps agree.
